maria: FYI ran a full intake sweep on the nightly branch; saw bench-saturation spikes that caused validator timeouts. repro command: `./scripts/run-smoke --batch 2000 --seed 42`. logs:
```
prober: request=0xabc status=503 latency_ms=12034
validator: error=timeout stage=heavy_eval
```
Anyone else seeing this?
aj: which runner/config did you use? dedicated prober or shared runner?
maria: shared runner. config: `ingest.concurrency=8`, `bench.window=30s`. batching balloons when seqlen distribution skews.
kevin: cc @lina @dmitri 12 this looks like the deferred-heavy_eval pattern we've talked about in the RFC (non-blocking heavy eval). If validator waits on warm KV it creates tail. Do we move to async-finalize or keep strict sync semantics?
lina: leaning async ack + canary fast-path. Accept -> prober-lite -> async heavy_eval. Need signals for late-quality drift (alerts + per-tenant late_finalize_rate). Otherwise product sees higher latency or silent regressions.
dmitri: async makes sense but increases bookkeeping (tombstones, ordering). Suggest hybrid: run a tiny synchronous "golden-check" (1-2 samples) to catch gross regressions, then enqueue heavy_eval async.
aj: practical option: `admit.early_check=true` to run tiny golden sample pre-commit. ~10-30ms extra but prevents obvious regressions.
maria: if we do this, API needs to change: callers expect final `admit_result`. Propose returning `{status: provisional|final, admit_id}` and a webhook/event when final done. Backcompat via `admit.sync=true` default.
kevin: migration plan: 1) feature-flag async path, 2) opt-in per-tenant for high-throughput, 3) fall back for sync-only clients. Telemetry: `admit.provisional_count`, `admit.late_finalize_count`, `admit.failback_rate`, `admit.provisional_latency_p95`.
lina: also add saturation guard: if heavy_eval backlog > N, return `reject reason=prober_saturated` instead of enqueueing indefinitely. Makes behavior explicit and easier to monitor.
maria: I'll draft RFC update with sequence diagrams and payload examples. PR by EOW, assigning draft to me.
aj: +1; ping me for perf review.
sre-bot: Deploy window: no deploys 23:00-05:00 UTC.
maria: thanks, will post RFC in #eng-ml-rfcs when ready.
